test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **"storehouse".** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the role of newspapers in providing information about daily events around the world and influencing public opinion on various matters.
 
• The term **“storehouse” **metaphorically refers to a repository or a place where a large amount of something is stored.
 
• In the context of newspapers being a source of information about day-to-day happenings, **"storehouse" **aptly conveys the idea of newspapers as a vast source or collection of news and information.
 
• **“Storehouse” **accurately reflects the newspapers' function of accumulating and presenting a wide range of information on different topics, making it an appropriate choice for depicting the comprehensive nature of news coverage.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Habitat - **This term primarily refers to the natural environment of a living organism.

 
 
• It does not appropriately convey the idea of a source of information.
 
 
 
• **Location - **While “location” refers to a specific place, it doesn't capture the concept of a collection or source of information inherent to newspapers.
 
• **Warehouse - **Although **“warehouse” **could metaphorically suggest a large storage space, similar to “storehouse,” it is more commonly associated with physical goods rather than information or knowledge, making “storehouse” a more fitting metaphor in this context.
